description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5999016283461 SHIELD,ELECTRONIC C: Line 0001 Qty 14 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0096 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
